segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹר שֶׁהָיָה מִתְחַכֵּךְ בַּכּוֹתֶל – וְנָפַל עַל הָאָדָם; נִתְכַּוֵּין לַהֲרוֹג אֶת הַבְּהֵמָה – וְהָרַג אֶת הָאָדָם; לְגוֹי – וְהָרַג בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵל; לִנְפָלִים – וְהָרַג בֶּן קַיָּימָא; פָּטוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «an ox was rubbing against a wall, and» as a result the wall «fell on a person» and killed him; or if the ox «intended to kill» another «animal but killed a person;» or if it intended «to» kill «a gentile but killed a Jew;» or intended «to» kill «a non-viable baby but killed a viable person;» in all these cases the ox is «exempt» from being killed.

positions.claim: ox exempt when killing without intent to kill that person
